bead.title: bench-pr-A1: fizeau-harbor-runner Docker image + content-sha build/preflight
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The current runner forces the host to have Python. cmd/bench/matrix.go:1105 prepends the repo root to the host PYTHONPATH so Harbor can import scripts.benchmark.harbor_adapters.*, and Harbor + its plugins then run in-process on host Python. The target architecture is host = bash + Node + Docker only.

ROOT CAUSE: Harbor and its agent plugins execute on the host interpreter via the PYTHONPATH injection at cmd/bench/matrix.go:1105; there is no container boundary around Harbor.

PROPOSED FIX:
- scripts/benchmark/Dockerfile.harbor-runner: FROM python:3.12-slim; RUN pip install --no-cache-dir harbor-bench==<pinned-version>; COPY scripts/benchmark/harbor_adapters/ /app/harbor_adapters/; COPY scripts/benchmark/harbor_agent.py /app/harbor_agent.py; ENV PYTHONPATH=/app; WORKDIR /app; ENTRYPOINT ["harbor"].
- scripts/benchmark/build-harbor-runner.sh: docker build tagging fizeau-harbor-runner:latest with an image-content-sha label = sha256 over harbor_adapters/ + harbor_agent.py + Dockerfile.harbor-runner.
- Expose a check hook used later by `./benchmark preflight`: compare cached image label to current content sha and rebuild on mismatch.
- Pre-work spike (5 min): confirm `pip install harbor-bench==<pinned>` resolves; if Harbor is git-only, switch to `pip install git+https://github.com/laude-institute/...` and record the pinned ref in the Dockerfile.

NON-SCOPE: the bash runner script (A3); shell harness/task adapters and CONTRACT.md (A2); concurrency/signals/budget (A4); Go-side changes, parity, deactivation (A5); cell-report.schema.json (PR B); tasks_from/task_executor bench-set schema (PR C); Node collector (PR D); Node importers (PR E); deleting cmd/bench (PR F); docs (PR G).

GOVERNING ARTIFACT: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

DEPENDENCIES: none (foundation). A3 and A2's harbor task-executor depend on this image existing.

ACCEPTANCE (numbered; Test* symbols live in scripts/benchmark/tests/harbor-runner.bats):
1. Test_harbor_runner_image_builds: build-harbor-runner.sh produces fizeau-harbor-runner:latest and `docker run --rm fizeau-harbor-runner:latest --help` exits 0.
2. Test_image_label_matches_content_sha: the built image's image-content-sha label equals the sha256 computed over harbor_adapters/ + harbor_agent.py + Dockerfile.harbor-runner.
3. Test_label_changes_when_adapter_changes: mutating any harbor_adapters/*.py changes the computed content sha (and a rebuild is triggered).
Gates: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes (shellcheck + bats over scripts/benchmark); `go test ./...` passes (no Go regressions).
bead.acceptance: Test_harbor_runner_image_builds, Test_image_label_matches_content_sha, and Test_label_changes_when_adapter_changes pass; lefthook pre-commit and go test ./... pass.
